AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving animal products? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving animal products.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving animal products.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving animal products.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving animal products.

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.

7. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil Conservation Measures? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil Conservation Measures.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil Conservation Measures.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Soil Conservation Measures.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil Conservation Measures.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preparation of Animal Products? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preparation of Animal Products.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Preparation of Animal Products.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preparation of Animal Products.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preparation of Animal Products.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Kitchen and Backyard Gardening? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning the Kitchen? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning the Kitchen.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning the Kitchen.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning the Kitchen.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning the Kitchen.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Kitchen and Backyard Gardening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Poultry Rearing in a Fold and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Crop Pest and Disease Control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Preparation of Animal Products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — 100 °C

2. C — Glucose and oxygen

3. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving animal products.

4. D — newton (N)

5. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.

6. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.

7. A — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

8. D — Producers

9. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil Conservation Measures.

10. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preparation of Animal Products.

11. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.

12. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning the Kitchen.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Crop Pest and Disease Control; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Preparation of Animal Products; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
